name: python-dijkstra
title: Dijkstra Route Walker
blurb: single-source shortest paths over small nonneg-weight integer-keyed digraphs: the walker's distance map equals the shipped fixed-point oracle's map on every shipped and seeded corpus, every shipped path costs exactly the map's cost, and unreachable nodes stay out of the map.
default_description: A shortest-path walker whose distance map is the relaxation oracle's map on every small weighted digraph, and whose routes cost what the map says.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a node is settled only when no edge can lower its cost
